Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray and CT images demonstrate an ill-defined area of consolidation in the left lower lobe (specifically the superior/apical segment) without associated hilar or mediastinal lymphadenopathy. This radiographic pattern, particularly when unresponsive to antibiotics, is characteristic of Bronchiolitis Obliterans Organizing Pneumonia (BOOP), also known as Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP).
